_readme: Made-up example. Copy to applicant_profile.json (gitignored) on your computer, or paste your filled-in copy into the APPLICANT_PROFILE GitHub secret. Never commit your real one: this repo is public. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_move_in_date: Leave empty to use each unit's own available date. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
_extra_fields: Any other field, by the text of its label (part of it is enough). true/false ticks or unticks a checkbox.
_radio_choices: Yes/no-style questions: the question's text (part of it is enough) -> the option to pick.
